fields.name: partage_entreprise
fields.title: Authorize this excerpt in shared company memory

options.label: Yes, members authorized to access shared memory may view this excerpt

actions.code: const x={{ json . }}; if(x.partage_entreprise!=="oui") throw new Error("company_memory_publication_confirmation_required"); if(x.confirmation_manuelle!=="oui") throw new Error("manual_confirmation_required"); for(const f of ["dossier_id","proposal_id"]) if(typeof x[f]!=="string"||!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,48}$/.test(x[f])) throw new Error("invalid_id"); if(typeof x.selected_excerpt!=="string"||!x.selected_excerpt.trim()||x.selected_excerpt.length>6000) throw new Error("invalid_excerpt"); if(typeof x.review_due!=="string"||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(x.review_due)||Number.isNaN(Date.parse(x.review_due))||Date.parse(x.review_due)<=Date.now()) throw new Error("invalid_review_due"); return {dossier_id:x.dossier_id,proposal_id:x.proposal_id,source_id:"vei-"+x.proposal_id,excerpt:x.selected_excerpt,review_due:x.review_due};

import { callTool } from './tools/nats_bridge.ts';
const x={{ json .request }}; const r=await callTool("recipe--application_data_v1",{operation:"read",namespace:"cib-veille",record_key:x.dossier_id}); if(!r.record?.permissions?.can_manage) throw new Error("only_owner_may_publish_to_company_memory"); return {data:{record:r.record.data}};

const r={{ json .local.data.record }}; const x={{ json .request }}; if(!r||r.role!=="veille"||typeof r.faits!=="string"||!r.faits.includes(x.excerpt)) throw new Error("excerpt_not_in_local_record"); return {source_ref:"company-in-a-box://veille/"+x.dossier_id,content:x.excerpt,source_date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)};
